```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ================================
# Create plots directory
# ================================
plot_dir <- file.path(params$output, "plots/06.1_correlation_AD")
if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
  dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Date prefix for descriptive filenames
date_prefix <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

# ================================
# Helper function to save plots
# ================================
save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  full_path <- file.path(plot_dir, paste0(date_prefix, "_", filename))
  
  if (inherits(plot_obj, "ggplot")) {
    # ggplot2 objects
    ggsave(full_path, plot = plot_obj, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  } else if (inherits(plot_obj, "Heatmap") || inherits(plot_obj, "HeatmapList")) {
    # ComplexHeatmap objects - save as PDF
    pdf(full_path, width = width, height = height)
    draw(plot_obj)
    dev.off()
  } else {
    # Base R plots or other objects - assume already rendered, save via dev.copy
    dev.copy(pdf, full_path, width = width, height = height)
    dev.off()
  }
  message("Saved: ", full_path)
}

# ================================
# Global chunk options - no automatic plot saving
# ================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 300,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6
)
```

# Validation using scRNA-seq data by Fetahu et al. {#fetahu}
To evaluate the validity of metacluster annnotations, we compare the cell expression profiles to our previously generated scRNA-seq dataset of NB bone marrow samples ([Fetahu et al.](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-39210-0) downloaded from [Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7707614). 

## Load libraries
<details>
   <summary>Load libraries</summary>
   
```{r load-libraries}
library(SingleR)
library(Seurat)
library(bruceR)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(BiocParallel)
library(dittoSeq)
```

```{r}

# ------------------------------
# Load packages and data
# ------------------------------
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SingleR)
library(scater)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)

spe_AD <- readRDS(file.path(params$output,"spe_04_phenotyping_AD.rds"))
spe_PTBM <- readRDS(file.path(params$output,"spe_04_phenotyping.rds"))

# Celltype colors from the AD reference object. Plots colored by the
# transferred (predicted fetal) labels reuse this vector so they follow the
# spe_AD color scheme.
col_celltype_AD <- metadata(spe_AD)$color_vectors$col_celltype

# Ordered AD celltype names (celltype_order_AD.csv) so the predicted-fetal plots
# order their legends/axes by the AD celltype order instead of alphabetically.
# Searched in R_intermediary like the other intermediaries; falls back to input.
ad_order_dirs <- c(Sys.getenv("MAPMET_INTERMEDIARY", ""),
                   file.path(params$input,  "R_intermediary"),
                   file.path(dirname(params$input), "R_intermediary"),
                   file.path(params$output, "R_intermediary"),
                   params$input)
ad_order_dirs <- ad_order_dirs[nzchar(ad_order_dirs)]
ad_order_file <- Find(file.exists, file.path(ad_order_dirs, "celltype_order_AD.csv"))
if (is.null(ad_order_file))
  stop("celltype_order_AD.csv not found in: ", paste(ad_order_dirs, collapse = ", "))
ad_order <- read.csv(ad_order_file, sep = ";", colClasses = c("order" = "character"))
ordered_AD_celltypes <- ad_order$celltype[order(ad_order$order)]

# Order predicted-fetal labels by the AD celltype order (any unexpected label is
# appended so no cell is dropped to NA).
order_fetal <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  factor(x, levels = c(ordered_AD_celltypes,
                       setdiff(unique(x), ordered_AD_celltypes)))
}
```

```{r}

# ------------------------------
# 2. Prepare reference and query
# ------------------------------
ref_counts <- assay(spe_AD, "counts")
ref_labels <- spe_AD$celltype

query_counts <- assay(spe_PTBM, "counts")

# ------------------------------
# 3. Run SingleR label transfer (per cluster)
# ------------------------------
singleR_results <- SingleR(
  test = query_counts,
  ref = ref_counts,
  labels = ref_labels,
  method = "cluster",
  clusters = spe_PTBM$celltype
)

# Add predicted fetal labels to neuroblastoma object
#spe_PTBM$predicted_fetal <- singleR_results$labels
cluster_to_label <- setNames(singleR_results$labels, rownames(singleR_results))
spe_PTBM$predicted_fetal <- order_fetal(cluster_to_label[as.character(spe_PTBM$celltype)])

```

```{r}

# ------------------------------
# 4. Compute mean marker expression per cluster
# ------------------------------
# Extract marker data
marker_df <- as.data.frame(t(assay(spe_PTBM, "counts")))  # cells x markers
colnames(marker_df) <- rownames(spe_PTBM)                 # optional: marker names

# Combine with metadata
meta_df <- as.data.frame(colData(spe_PTBM))
df <- cbind(meta_df, marker_df)

# Compute mean expression per cluster x predicted_fetal
mean_expr <- df %>%
  group_by(pg_clusters, predicted_fetal) %>%
  summarize(across(ends_with("_mean"), mean), .groups = "drop")

expr_matrix <- as.matrix(mean_expr[,-(1:2)])
rownames(expr_matrix) <- paste(mean_expr$pg_clusters, mean_expr$predicted_fetal, sep="_")
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)

# df already contains metadata + marker data
# Compute mean expression per cluster x predicted fetal
mean_expr <- df %>%
  group_by(pg_clusters, predicted_fetal) %>%
  summarize(across(ends_with("_mean"), mean), .groups = "drop")

# Reshape to wide format: rows = pg_clusters, cols = predicted_fetal
heatmap_df <- mean_expr %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = predicted_fetal, values_from = ends_with("_mean"), 
              values_fn = mean)  # takes mean if multiple markers, you can pick one or use PCA

# For simplicity, let's take mean across all markers for similarity
library(tibble)  # for column_to_rownames()

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("pg_clusters") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Correlation between neuroblastoma clusters (rows) and fetal types (columns)
sim_matrix <- cor(t(heatmap_matrix), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")  
sim_matrix[is.na(sim_matrix)] <- 0

# Plot
ph <- pheatmap(sim_matrix,
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
         main = "Neuroblastoma clusters vs Fetal progenitors")
save_plot(ph, "correlation-clusters-vs-fetal.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

# ------------------------------
# 6. UMAP colored by predicted fetal labels
# ------------------------------
p_umap_fetal <- plotUMAP(spe_PTBM, colour_by = "predicted_fetal") +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_celltype_AD) +
  # Harmonised square panel border (all UMAPs): plotUMAP draws only the L-shaped
  # axis lines, so replace them with a closed rectangle.
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        axis.line    = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5))
save_plot(p_umap_fetal, "umap-predicted-fetal.pdf", width = 16, height = 8)
p_umap_fetal

# ------------------------------
# 7. Spatial plot colored by predicted fetal labels
# ------------------------------
coords <- as.data.frame(spatialCoords(spe_PTBM))
coords$predicted_fetal <- spe_PTBM$predicted_fetal

p_spatial_fetal <- ggplot(coords, aes(x = Pos_X, y = Pos_Y, color = predicted_fetal)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_celltype_AD) +
  labs(title = "Spatial mapping of predicted fetal progenitors") +
  theme_minimal()
save_plot(p_spatial_fetal, "spatial-predicted-fetal.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
p_spatial_fetal

```
```{r}
# ------------------------------
# Full heatmap with correct cluster names
# ------------------------------

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)

# 1. Read ordered cluster names
# celltype_order.csv ships in R_intermediary; search it there (like the other
# frozen intermediaries) and fall back to params$input for older data layouts.
order_dirs <- c(Sys.getenv("MAPMET_INTERMEDIARY", ""),
                file.path(params$input,  "R_intermediary"),
                file.path(dirname(params$input), "R_intermediary"),
                file.path(params$output, "R_intermediary"),
                params$input)
order_dirs <- order_dirs[nzchar(order_dirs)]
order_file <- Find(file.exists, file.path(order_dirs, "celltype_order.csv"))
if (is.null(order_file))
  stop("celltype_order.csv not found in: ", paste(order_dirs, collapse = ", "))
clusternames_ordered <- read.csv(order_file,
                                sep = ";", colClasses = c("order" = "character"))
ordered_clusters <- clusternames_ordered$celltype

# 2. Extract SingleR clusters from the object (not the scores matrix)
singleR_clusters <- rownames(singleR_results)

# 3. Extract scores matrix
score_matrix <- singleR_results$scores

# 4. Assign rownames to match cluster IDs
rownames(score_matrix) <- singleR_clusters

# 5. Map cluster IDs to your ordered names (ensure all clusters are mapped)
# Here we assume ordered_clusters corresponds to singleR_clusters in the correct order
score_matrix <- score_matrix[match(ordered_clusters, singleR_clusters), , drop = FALSE]

# 6. Convert to long format
score_df <- as.data.frame(score_matrix) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Neuroblastoma_cluster") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Neuroblastoma_cluster, names_to = "Fetal_AD_celltype", values_to = "score")

# 7. Factor for y-axis ordering
score_df$Neuroblastoma_cluster <- factor(score_df$Neuroblastoma_cluster, levels = ordered_clusters)

# 8. Plot heatmap
p_singler_scores <- ggplot(score_df, aes(x = Fetal_AD_celltype, y = Neuroblastoma_cluster, fill = score)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = intersect(ordered_AD_celltypes,
                                      unique(as.character(score_df$Fetal_AD_celltype)))) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = ordered_clusters) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Fetal AD celltype", y = "Neuroblastoma cluster", fill = "SingleR score")
save_plot(p_singler_scores, "singler-scores-heatmap.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
p_singler_scores
```

```{r singler-scores-tumor-metacluster}
# ------------------------------
# SingleR score heatmap keeping the tumor celltypes separate but grouping every
# non-tumor cell at the metacluster level. This re-runs the cluster-level label
# transfer on a hybrid grouping (tumor -> fine celltype, else -> metacluster).
# ------------------------------
hybrid_group <- ifelse(as.character(spe_PTBM$metacluster) == "tumor",
                       as.character(spe_PTBM$celltype),
                       as.character(spe_PTBM$metacluster))

singleR_hybrid <- SingleR(
  test     = query_counts,
  ref      = ref_counts,
  labels   = ref_labels,
  method   = "cluster",
  clusters = hybrid_group
)

# Row order: tumor celltypes first (in celltype_order.csv order), then the
# remaining metacluster-level groups (alphabetical).
tumor_cts <- ordered_clusters[ordered_clusters %in%
             unique(as.character(spe_PTBM$celltype)[spe_PTBM$metacluster == "tumor"])]
score_matrix_h <- singleR_hybrid$scores
present_rows    <- rownames(score_matrix_h)
row_order_hybrid <- c(intersect(tumor_cts, present_rows),
                      sort(setdiff(present_rows, tumor_cts)))
score_matrix_h <- score_matrix_h[row_order_hybrid, , drop = FALSE]

score_df_h <- as.data.frame(score_matrix_h) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Neuroblastoma_group") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Neuroblastoma_group, names_to = "Fetal_AD_celltype", values_to = "score")
score_df_h$Neuroblastoma_group <- factor(score_df_h$Neuroblastoma_group, levels = row_order_hybrid)

p_singler_scores_hybrid <- ggplot(score_df_h,
    aes(x = Fetal_AD_celltype, y = Neuroblastoma_group, fill = score)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = intersect(ordered_AD_celltypes,
                                      unique(as.character(score_df_h$Fetal_AD_celltype)))) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = row_order_hybrid) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Fetal AD celltype", y = "PT/BM tumor celltype / metacluster",
       fill = "SingleR score")
save_plot(p_singler_scores_hybrid,
          "singler-scores-heatmap-tumor-celltypes-metaclusters.pdf",
          width = 8, height = 6)
p_singler_scores_hybrid
```
```{r}

ref_counts <- assay(spe_AD, "counts")
ref_labels <- spe_AD$celltype

query_counts <- assay(spe_PTBM, "counts")

# ------------------------------
# Run SingleR at CELL LEVEL
# ------------------------------
singleR_cell <- SingleR(
  test = query_counts,
  ref = ref_counts,
  labels = ref_labels
)

# ------------------------------
# Assign labels to each NB cell
# ------------------------------
spe_PTBM$predicted_fetal_cell <- order_fetal(singleR_cell$labels)
```

```{r}
p_umap_fetal_cell <- plotUMAP(spe_PTBM, colour_by = "predicted_fetal_cell", point_size = 0.05) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_celltype_AD,
                     name = "Predicted foetal adrenal gland celltype") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
  # Full square panel border to match the dittoDimPlot (theme_bw) style of
  # 04_phenotyping/umap-celltypes.pdf. plotUMAP draws only the bottom/left axis
  # lines (an L); replace them with a closed rectangle on all four sides.
  # element_rect uses `size` (not `linewidth`) for compatibility with the older
  # ggplot2 in the image; `linewidth` on theme elements only exists from 3.4.0
  # and errors ("unused argument") on earlier versions.
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        axis.line    = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5))
save_plot(p_umap_fetal_cell, "umap-predicted-fetal-cell.pdf", width = 16, height = 8)
p_umap_fetal_cell
```

```{r singler-cell-composition-heatmap}
# ------------------------------
# Cell-level composition heatmap: same axes as singler-scores-heatmap.pdf, but
# the colour is taken from the per-cell label transfer (singleR_cell) instead of
# the SingleR scores. Each tile is the % of cells of a given PT/BM celltype (row)
# that were assigned to a given AD celltype (column) - e.g. the fraction of
# "neuroblast-like TU" cells predicted as "Early Neuroblasts". Rows sum to 100%.
# ------------------------------
comp_tab <- table(
  Neuroblastoma_cluster = factor(as.character(spe_PTBM$celltype), levels = ordered_clusters),
  Fetal_AD_celltype     = factor(as.character(singleR_cell$labels))
)
comp_prop <- prop.table(comp_tab, margin = 1) * 100   # row-normalised percentages
comp_df   <- as.data.frame(comp_prop, responseName = "percent")

p_singler_composition <- ggplot(comp_df,
    aes(x = Fetal_AD_celltype, y = Neuroblastoma_cluster, fill = percent)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = intersect(ordered_AD_celltypes,
                                      unique(as.character(comp_df$Fetal_AD_celltype)))) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = ordered_clusters) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Fetal AD celltype", y = "Neuroblastoma cluster",
       fill = "% of cells")
save_plot(p_singler_composition, "singler-celltype-composition-heatmap.pdf",
          width = 8, height = 6)
p_singler_composition
```
